# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## System and Window Information

- **Operating System**: Linux (based on desktop environment and application icons)
- **Window Title**: "Welcome - project - Visual Studio Code"
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 23 01:52" displayed in the top bar
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons located at the top-right corner
- **Application Icon**: Visual Studio Code icon (blue "VS" logo) visible in the top-left corner of the window
- **Desktop Environment**: GNOME (indicated by "Activities" button and dock layout)

## Application Menu and Toolbar

### Top Menu Bar
- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help
- **File Menu**: Currently open, displaying a dropdown list of options
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Displayed next to each menu item for quick reference

### File Menu Options
- **New Text File**: Ctrl+N
- **New File...**: Alt+Ctrl+N
- **New Window**: Ctrl+Shift+N
- **Open File...**: Ctrl+O
- **Open Folder...**: [Ctrl+K Ctrl+O]
- **Open Workspace from File...**
- **Open Recent** (with right-pointing arrow indicating submenu)
- **Add Folder to Workspace...**
- **Save Workspace As...**
- **Duplicate Workspace**
- **Save**: Ctrl+S
- **Save As...**: Ctrl+Shift+S
- **Save All**
- **Share** (with right-pointing arrow indicating submenu)
- **Auto Save**
- **Preferences** (with right-pointing arrow indicating submenu)
- **Revert File**
- **Close Editor**
- **Close Folder**: [Ctrl+K F]
- **Close Window**: Alt+F4
- **Exit**: Ctrl+Q

## Main Workspace Area

### Welcome Page Content
- **Title**: "Visual Studio Code"
- **Subtitle**: "Editing evolved"
- **Start Section**:
  - **New File...** (with file icon)
  - **Open File...** (with folder icon)
  - **Open Folder...** (with folder icon)
  - **Clone Git Repository...** (with Git icon)
  - **Connect to...** (with connection icon)
- **Recent Section**:
  - Text: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - **Get Started with VS Code** (with star icon) - "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding" (highlighted with blue underline)
  - **Get Started with Python Development** (with Python icon) - "New" badge
  - **Learn the Fundamentals** (with lightbulb icon)

### Status Bar
- **Checkbox**: "Show welcome page on startup" (checked)
- **Filter Bar**: "Filter (e.g. text, **/*.ts, !**/*.hod...)" with filter icon, list icon, and clear icon

## Activity Bar (Left Sidebar)

- **Application Icons** (from top to bottom):
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird (email client)
  - Visual Studio Code (active)
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP (image editor)
  - File Manager
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (question mark icon)
  - Trash (recycle bin)

## Bottom Panel

### Activity Bar (Bottom Left)
- **User Icon** (person silhouette)
- **Settings Icon** (gear icon) with notification badge "1"

### Status Bar (Bottom)
- **Status Indicators**:
  - **Source Control**: No changes (green checkmark)

  - **Terminal**: No active terminal sessions (terminal icon)
  - **Ports**: No active ports (port icon)
- **Status Bar Icons**:
  - **Source Control**: Green checkmark

## Editor Tabs

- **Active Tab**: "Welcome" (with close button "X")
- **Other Tab**: "text_search.py" (with close button "X")

- **Tab Bar**: Located at the top of the editor area with tab names and close buttons
